verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API supports programmatic management of API keys and other resources (docs-11, docs-27), and agents can connect via the official MCP integration (docs-9), implying credential-based access, but there is no explicit documentation of scoped/least-privilege permission levels for API keys or agent-specific credential scoping. missing for 10: explicit docs on creating role-restricted or scoped API keys, least-privilege permission tiers, or agent-specific credential issuance workflow.
